children: Matrix Service reported results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, with Q4 revenue of $244.5 million and net income of $1.1 million. The company recorded adjusted net income of $4.6 million (adjusted diluted EPS $0.16) for the quarter and exited the year with $283.9 million of liquidity and no outstanding debt. Full-year revenue was $873.6 million with adjusted EBITDA of $16.0 million for fiscal 2026.
Revenue (Q4 FY2026): $244.5 million (versus $216.4 million prior-year period)
Gross profit (Q4 FY2026): $19.5 million; gross margin 8.0%
Operating loss (Q4 FY2026): $(0.9) million; Net income (Q4 FY2026): $1.1 million (diluted EPS $0.04)
Adjusted net income (Q4 FY2026): $4.6 million; adjusted diluted EPS $0.16
Liquidity at June 30, 2026: $283.9 million (comprised of $223.0 million unrestricted cash and $60.9 million borrowing availability); no outstanding debt
Quarterly revenue reached a six-year high, driven primarily by increased specialty storage activity in the Storage and Terminal Solutions segment.

Total backlog as of June 30, 2026 was $953.2 million; project awards in Q4 totaled $169.0 million with notable awards concentrated in Process and Industrial Facilities, including a major mining construction project in the western United States.
Storage and Terminal Solutions segment revenue rose 43% year-over-year to $137.4 million, with gross margin recovery versus the prior-year quarter.
Utility and Power Infrastructure delivered steady revenue ($73.5 million in Q4) and improved gross margin to 12.8% due to strong project execution.

Company executed organizational realignment and cost-reduction actions during the year; incurred $3.4 million of restructuring costs in the quarter related to leadership transitions and workforce reductions.

title: Matrix Service posts Q4 FY2026 revenue $244.5M, adjusted EPS $0.16 and liquidity $283.9M
